<!-- compiled_truth -->
**Decided:** self-hosted woff2 subsets (latin + latin-ext via unicode-range) loaded with **`font-display: optional`** (not the handoff's `swap`), metric-matched local fallback faces generated by fontaine (`src/styles/font-overrides.css`, `npm run fonts:overrides`), and preload limited to the three critical latin faces (Fraunces roman, Plex Sans 400, Plex Mono 500). Fraunces ships the **standard axis subset (opsz, wght)** — the full-axis file's SOFT/WONK cost +52KB roman / +70KB italic, so WONK-1-at-display was cut (the handoff lists it as an "e.g.", and the Chanel rule applies).

**Rationale:** the handoff's own gates (CLS = 0, LCP < 1.5s) are unsatisfiable with `swap`: any late swap repaints the hero h1 larger and shifts the lede (measured CLS 0.152→0.0065 even with overrides). With `optional` + preloads, fonts beat the ~100ms block window on real connections (LCP 848ms throttled) and any miss renders into a metric-identical fallback box — invisible, CLS 0.00000. WONK was the accessory removed.

**Blast radius:** fallback overrides match Georgia/Arial/Courier New — platforms lacking them (some Linux, incl. CI runners) may see residual swap-free reflow; overrides must be regenerated if fonts change; swapping back to `swap` breaks the CLS gate. Amends [[performance-as-design-feature]]; enabled by [[lhci-devtools-throttling]].
